candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately if _tos.length == 0 instead of requiring it, altering return behavior for that input.
Invert final return: return false instead of true after successful loop, changing return value when all external calls succeed.
Change behavior to return the success flag of the last external call instead of always true, making returned value reflect that call.
Replace the low-level call that performs transferFrom with a call that passes v+1 instead of v, changing the amount forwarded to the callee and thus altering any state it records for transfers.
Replace the low-level call to use v-1 (underflow protected by Solidity 0.8 checks) altering the amount sent to the callee and therefore its recorded transfer state.
Replace the call so the selector uses transfer(address,address,uint256) (different target function), changing which callee function runs and thus its observable state changes.
